input.quote: 22.14 Solicitation. Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding Tri City National Bank. Searches for "compete/competing", "shall not engage", "exclusive", "restrict", "in-house" and "similar services" returned only severability language (p0298), IP/confidentiality provisions (§ 17, including 17.2 confirming Customer has no rights in M&I software — a standard IP statement, not a covenant not to compete), the § 23 source code licence scope, and the mutual employee non-solicit at 22.14. The only restrictive covenant, 22.14, is mutual, limited to employee solicitation during the Term, and does not restrict what businesses we may operate or what products we may buy or build. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
